FN-MEZOH1-1
lFISCAL NOTE
House Bill 216
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Russell Bedsole
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/11/2023
House Bill 216 as introduced could decrease the obligations of the Department of Corrections
by an undetermined amount dependent on any decrease in license plate production due to the
provisions of this bill.
